items.description: Custom tab with the stock range date picker behind it: date-only yyyy-MM-dd format, city timezone, today minimum with past dates disabled, explicit confirm enabled (no auto-commit, no per-tick filtering), boot-computed forward presets (Next 7, Next 30, This-month-remainder, recomputed at boot plus day-rollover). items.description: Invoke the code-review skill against the work completed in this loop, then append the findings as agent follow-ups IN THE SAME LOOP ITERATION. Fixed point: origin/main (three-dot diff origin/main...HEAD on branch feat/103-improved-date-filtering). Standards axis: repo conventions plus the skill's smell baseline. Spec axis: the original spec in issue #103. Report under ## Standards and ## Spec without merging the axes, ending with per-axis totals and worst issue per axis. Do NOT fix code in this item; fixes happen in later loops under tdd and disciplined-engineering. After the report, translate every non-deferred finding into a new follow-up item appended to this prd.json: one finding per item, each small and one-task shaped with reviewer-judgeable done criteria, each carrying title, description, passes:false, reference (the #103 spec line or the owning ticket #104-#108), and priority 10, 20, 30, ... in dependency order (spec-correctness before standards-polish, dependencies first). Findings closable only by human acceptance in issue #109 (keyboard-only completion, screen-reader pressed announcement, focus and Escape discipline, count-on-commit, 360px wrap, full live-data browser checklist) are NEVER appended — itemize them as deferred-to-#109 in notes instead. Never append a second review item; the review runs once. Done when: the two-axis report is in notes (every Spec finding quoting its #103 line, deferred-to-#109 list included) AND all non-deferred findings exist as appended follow-up items; then set passes:true on this item and stop. The loop continues onto the follow-ups by priority and may only emit COMPLETE when they are all passes:true.
